mcp_tools.name: semantic_html_review
mcp_tools.title: Semantic html review
mcp_tools.description: Submits a semantic HTML review record for one page (declared landmarks, heading outline rows, semantic elements, controls with declared form-input rows, media with declared image rows, declared data-table rows, document head, ARIA practice, validation, red lines) and returns a deterministic SEMANTIC_HTML_REVIEW_SOUND / SEMANTIC_HTML_REVIEW_DEFICIENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across nine sections, including computed heading-outline, label-binding, alt-text and table-structure checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared review record only; it fetches and parses no live page.

inputSchema.description: The semantic html review manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: computed_spot_checks: headings_count=1, h1_count=1, form_inputs_count=1, images_count=1, data_tables_count=1
